tasks.short: Read schedules and agree material-transfer procedures

steps.what: Read production and delivery schedules and confer with supervisors about pallet transfer procedures

tasks.design: Keep schedule reading and procedural clarification with the conveyor operator and supervisor. {OPS_SYSTEM} may show current schedules, while understanding the physical arrangement and destination remains counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Transfer procedures depend on actual packages, destinations and operational conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported replacement of procedural discussion is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving unclear instructions before physical transfer.
tasks.human_edge: Practical judgement and confirmation with the supervisor.

reach.learn: Which package constraints change pallet arrangements

evidence.claim: Digital schedules do not remove the operator's need to read and clarify physical transfer procedures.

assumptions: Scope is schedule interpretation and procedural discussion, not production planning.
Supervisors produce schedules and instructions in their existing planning work; reading and clarification remain fully counted here.
Use current schedule displays before adding software.
No changed process means no incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Current schedule format and procedure complexity
research_questions: Which schedule ambiguities require supervisor discussion?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; no interpretation or discussion time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate movement requests and shipment notices

steps.what: Prepare movement requests or incoming shipment notices and check exact recipients and details
Contact the specified workers with the exact checked request or shipment notice
Confirm receipt, clarify movement requests and resolve unavailable workers or changed delivery times

tasks.design: Configure a fixed request form in {WORKFLOW} to send checked movement or shipment messages through {CHAT}. The operator still prepares the details and confirms receipt; urgent coordination remains a direct call.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly relaying the same checked details consumes contact time.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed forms and internal notifications can deliver exact messages without generative text.
tasks.still_hard: Ensuring the recipient can act and resolving changing physical conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The operator confirms practical readiness through conversation.

reach.learn: Distinguishing estimates from confirmed arrival times

evidence.claim: Fixed internal request forms can relay operator-entered details, but do not establish worker availability or physical readiness.

assumptions: Scope ends at coordination; recipient labour and physical movement are not claimed as savings.

In s1 the operator produces message type, material/shipment identifier, origin, destination, requested time, recipient and any planner-supplied estimated arrival time with source/time stamp. Capture and verification are counted in 40%; absent or stale estimates require a manual call.
The transport planner supplies and updates arrival estimates and department routing in 3 incremental other-role hours per 100 baseline. No automatic ready-to-move or available-worker flag is assumed.
Worker responses arise after s2; the operator waits for or obtains them in s3. Try native forms and notifications first; urgent requests and delivery failures use direct contact.
research_questions: How much relay time is saved after data capture and receipt confirmation?

incremental.description: Routing checks and additional delivery reconciliation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=70, gross=30%; minus 6 focal upkeep gives net 24%. Range 0-5% allows mostly live coordination and already automated notices; E1 scenario.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Physical operations supported by clear internal messages
reach: Coordinate estimate quality with transport planners
role.ambitious_version: Simple checked notifications reduce repeated relay while live coordination and safe physical work retain their time.
